title: Power Apps: refreshed row summary layout and Microsoft-provided summaries on view pages
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing requirements and three published control paths are supported. Calling summaries read-only is not supported by the documentation; minor corrections should acknowledge differing related-record link guidance and remove the checklist instruction for a control absent from the table.

claims.quote: The row summaries experience has a refreshed layout that makes AI-generated insights more prominent and easier to consume.

claims.quote: Improved visual hierarchy (including clearer spacing, background and border treatments, status indicators, and generation labels)

claims.claim: Row summaries are AI-generated overviews of a record in model-driven apps.

claims.claim: Custom row summaries appear in the Insights bar on main forms.
claims.quote: Forms: When viewing a record in a main form, the summary appears in the insights bar at the top of the main form.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: View pages expose summaries through an inline Summary action next to a grid record.
claims.quote: Views: When browsing records in a view, select the inline Summary action next to a record to open the summary in a modal popup.

claims.claim: The view-page Summary action opens the summary in a modal popup.
claims.quote: select the inline Summary action next to a record to open the summary in a modal popup.

claims.claim: Custom summaries require configured and enabled table prompts as well as environment enablement.
claims.quote: Makers still need to configure and turn on summary prompts on individual tables so that row summaries appear on the corresponding forms and views.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: The Learn row summary pages do not describe the refreshed visual layout at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" "refreshed" layout setting disable. Read record-summaries, configure-form-row-summary, faq-record-summaries and the archived release plan; none describes the refreshed spacing, borders, indicators and generation labels.

claims.claim: The linked release plan page is marked archived as of October 2026.
claims.quote: As of October 2026, this content is archived and no longer maintained.

claims.claim: The environment control is at Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary > Row summaries > environment > Edit setting.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Copilot, and then select Settings. Under Power Apps, locate Row summaries in the Summary section. Select the environment, and then select Edit setting.

claims.claim: An API or automation operation that sets the Row summaries environment control is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: row summaries Power Platform API, Set-AdminPowerAppEnvironment, pac admin; EnableFormInsights. Read settings PATCH REST reference, tutorial, SDK property and SettingsPatchRequestBody: property exists in a model, but the operation's request schema does not document it as a writable field.

claims.claim: The Row summaries environment setting controls row summaries on both main forms and view pages.
claims.quote: This setting controls row summaries on both model-driven app main forms and view pages.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends the Copilot settings experience as the primary environment-level control location.
claims.quote: Use the Copilot settings experience in the Power Platform admin center as the primary environment-level control for row summaries

claims.claim: The legacy control is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > AI insight cards.
claims.quote: select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Environments. On the Environments page, select an environment. In the command bar, select Settings. Expand Product, and then select Features. ... AI insight cards

claims.claim: An API or automation operation that sets the legacy AI insight cards control is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: AI insight cards API PowerShell organization setting; EnableFormInsights PowerShell API update. Read settings-features, environment settings PATCH reference, tutorial and SDK SettingsPatchRequestBody; no documented request field sets this capability.

claims.claim: AI insight cards and Row summaries control the same capability.
claims.quote: The AI insight cards setting on this page and Row summaries in Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary control the same capability.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft says the legacy AI insight cards setting location will be removed in a future release.
claims.quote: The AI insight cards setting remains available on this page for now but will be removed in a future release.

claims.claim: Updating the legacy feature settings requires the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions.
claims.quote: Ensure you have the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The maker control is at Power Apps > Tables > table > Customizations > Row summary > Show row summary.
claims.quote: In Power Apps, select Tables on the left navigation pane, and open the table with the configured row summary. Under Customizations, select Row summary. In the prompt configuration screen, use the Show row summary toggle

claims.claim: An API operation equivalent to the table's Show row summary toggle is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: row summary Show row summary API aiskillconfig; AI Skill Config IsEnabled; aiskillconfig Web API reference; AI Skill Config table/entity reference. Read maker guide and AI Skill Config dependency excerpts; no operation and property mapping for the visibility toggle was documented.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Turning off Show row summary hides the table's configured custom summary from main forms and view pages.
claims.quote: Turning off Show row summary hides the configured summary from all main forms and view pages for the table.

claims.claim: The maker toggle does not hide Microsoft-provided summaries or summaries configured through another application or experience.
claims.quote: It doesn't hide summaries provided by Microsoft or summaries configured through another application or experience, such as Customer Service summaries for custom tables.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; controls[3].api; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No separate UI or API switch for the refreshed layout is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: row summaries refreshed layout setting disable; row summaries Power Platform API. Read record-summaries, maker guide, FAQ, settings-features, Copilot hub, archived release plan and SDK environment settings model; found summary controls, not a separate visual-layout switch.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Scope: Roles
claims.claim: Makers choose a custom summary's columns in its Prompt box.
claims.quote: In the Prompt box, add the columns that you want included in the summary by selecting Add or by typing */*.

claims.claim: A Power Platform administrator enables Row summaries for the environment.
claims.quote: A Power Platform administrator must enable Row summaries for the environment in the Power Platform admin center

claims.where: Scope: Out of scope for custom summaries; Governance controls
claims.claim: Case, Lead and Opportunity are excluded from the custom row summary feature because Customer Service and Sales provide their own summaries.
claims.quote: Some Dynamics 365 apps tables, such as Case, Lead, and Opportunity, provide their own summaries via the Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Sales applications. To avoid conflicts, the row summary feature isn't available for these tables.

claims.claim: Learn describes summaries as read-only text.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" "read-only". Read record-summaries, configure-form-row-summary and faq-record-summaries; they describe generated text and interaction buttons but do not state that summaries are read-only.
claims.fix: Remove 'read-only' so the sentence reads: 'Learn describes summaries as text that users can copy, rate with thumbs up or down and, on forms, refresh.'

claims.claim: Users can copy summary content.
claims.quote: Copy: Select to copy the summary content directly to your clipboard for easy sharing or documentation.

claims.claim: Users can rate a summary with thumbs up or thumbs down.
claims.quote: Feedback: Use the thumbs up or thumbs down icons to rate the summary's usefulness.

claims.claim: Users can refresh a summary on forms.
claims.quote: Refresh (forms only): Select the Refresh button to regenerate the summary so it reflects the latest updates to the record.

claims.claim: The FAQ lists calculations as a limitation.
claims.quote: Row summaries can't currently perform calculations.

claims.claim: The FAQ says row summaries cannot currently reference relative dates.
claims.quote: Row summaries can't currently reference dates in relative terms, such as "yesterday" or "next week."

claims.claim: The FAQ lists links to related records as unsupported.
claims.quote: Row summaries can't include links to related records.
claims.fix: After the limits sentence add: 'The maker guide qualifies related-record links differently: "Hyperlinks to related records might not render as expected in the summary."' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/data-platform/configure-form-row-summary#known-limitations.

claims.claim: The FAQ advises treating a summary as a starting point rather than relying on it without reviewing source records.
claims.quote: Treat the row summary as a helpful starting point for understanding a record. Review the record's fields and related data directly before making important decisions based on that data.
